list: Official PS5 trophy list as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. All 55 are offline single-player; there are no online trophies. Names and descriptions below are the official ones; every guide is written in our own words and cites its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first and this one pops on its own the moment the last one lands. There is nothing extra to do for it: it is the reward for the whole list, so work the roadmap in order and it will come last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It is a story trophy, so it unlocks automatically when the mission ends and it cannot be missed.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before you leave this chapter, while you are here.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. After Coffee Break in this chapter you can play as both characters, which the later meditation spots need.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. A story trophy that unlocks automatically when the chapter closes; nothing special to do for it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. A story trophy that unlocks automatically when the chapter closes.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and the credits roll. This gold trophy pops automatically. After it, free roam continues, so everything you have not finished yet stays open.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is part of the main story, so it unlocks on its own as you play through the chapters.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically as part of the main story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically as part of the main story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically as part of the main story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks automatically as part of the main story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically as part of the main story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion on the checklist under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, which appears after the story. PowerPyx reports the checklist is lenient, closer to 60 percent true completion: you need 70 of the 80 Challenges, every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, but only 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. This is the hardest trophy and where most of the roughly 200 hours go, so start its pieces during the story because progress made earlier already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are jumps, airtime and trick driving in vehicles, and they add up wherever you drive, so keep attempting jumps and ramps during free roam instead of saving them for the end. PowerPyx lists the stunt count among the long grinds on the road to 100 percent.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. One attempt at each is enough: fishing, the shooting range, an arcade game, a drone race, bowling, meditation, hunting, a race and stunts. Work through them early and tick each type off as you try it.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PowerPyx reports the gold scores are not too hard: work through every range, learn each challenge's target pattern, and repeat a challenge until the gold score lands. Every range is also needed for 100 percent completion.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location: 14 locations in total, according to KeenGamer. Win once per spot; learn each course's turns and shortcuts, and fly the race again if you lose. Every location is also needed for 100 percent completion.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each win must be a different event, so spread your wins across the map instead of repeating one race. PowerPyx counts racing among the activities to clear in the cleanup step.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, take it on, and out-fish him: a bigger or better catch wins the challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also helps Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it through to its end. Any cabinet counts, so pick the shortest game you find.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is a Stranger: work through his mission strand until the last mission appears, then finish it. GTABase notes Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is a Stranger: work through his mission strand until the last mission appears, then finish it. Stranger strands stay open in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy is a Stranger: work through his mission strand until the last mission appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands in the game, so pick any 8 and finish each strand's missions. The Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone strands each end in their own trophy too, so those five count toward this one.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy is a Stranger: work through his mission strand until the last mission appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is a Stranger: work through his mission strand until the last mission appears, then finish it. GTABase notes Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as Jason.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, according to PowerPyx and KeenGamer. THIS IS THE LIST'S ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. The first meditation is Lucia's balcony session at Jason's house in Chapter 1, offered after the mission Down to Earth: do it before Chapter 1 ends, because guides report it disappears after the chapter. The last spots need both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Whether the Chapter 1 meditation is actually required is unconfirmed, but PowerPyx's author did it and earned the trophy, so doing it is the safe move.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are hunting quests: follow his strand, track the unique animal he names, and take it down. Bret's quests are also needed for 100 percent completion, and GTABase notes Bret's strand is Jason-only.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a set completes when you hold every card in it. Collect as you travel and check your card collection often so you know which sets are nearly done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to scan or photograph 100 different spots across Leonida. Do it as you travel so the count builds up naturally, and use it on unfamiliar vehicles and places too, since scanning feeds the 100 percent checklist.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 Challenges in 8 groups of 10, according to PowerPyx, and 50 is enough for the trophy, so skip the hardest ones and finish the fifty you find easiest. Seventy of the 80 are needed for 100 percent completion, so this trophy comes on the way to that one.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight, stay out of the search cones and keep moving until the stars clear. A quiet back road or a hiding spot away from patrols makes the escape easier.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row and keep the wanted level alive between them: plan a short route with three close shops, rob fast, and drive straight to the next one before the heat dies down.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you come across counts, so drive through new areas and scan unfamiliar vehicles with the WAiNK app as you go. The 100 percent checklist needs 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when they are close together, and drop five of them before it ends. A busy shootout gives you the best chance.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City International Airport. Get onto the airfield, take a plane that is not yours, and take off without a schedule or a ticket. Expect security on the way in, so go in fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Take a Rhino tank for a spin. Rhinos are military vehicles, so find one at a military site, get inside, and drive it around. The description's joke is the clue: it is about the Rhino tank, not a challenge list.

sources.name: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the guards, take what you came for and leave before anyone spots you. If an alarm goes off, you have been detected, so leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate vault jobs, escaping clean each time. Plan your getaway before you go in, and count each clean escape toward the five. Bank vaults are also part of the 100 percent checklist's robbery requirements.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash and get away clean. Armored trucks patrol the highways, so watch for one and strike when the road is clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area of the state until the map is filled in: 52 areas in total, according to the trophy's own tracking. Check the in-game map for gaps and drive or fly to the places you have not visited yet.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: one operation per gang, across all 9 gangs. Find each gang's operation, hit it, and move on to the next gang until every gang has been hit once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach with a view of the water, order a cocktail and drink it there. It is a quiet moment trophy, so take it slow.

sources.name: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a showroom's front window and out onto the street, the way the classic games did it. Any showroom with a glass front works.

sources.name: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to that alley, start a game of bowling and play it through. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so this also helps Master of None.

sources.name: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build your partnership's mass appeal. The game tracks how widely known Jason and Lucia's partnership becomes, and this trophy pops when that appeal reaches its mark. It builds as you play high-profile story and side activities together, so keep doing jobs as a duo.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices as they come, for better or worse. The game tracks a count of choices made, up to 500 according to HowToVideoGame, and this trophy pops when that count is reached. It accumulates across the whole playthrough, so keep choosing whenever the game offers you a decision.

sources.name: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. This is a second-attempt trophy: fail an activity once, then go back and clear it on the next attempt. KeenGamer lists its exact trigger as still being confirmed, so retry an activity you failed and the trophy should land on the second go.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger a strange open-world event, the kind that makes you ask what just happened. KeenGamer lists this hidden trophy's exact unlock method as unconfirmed, so explore Leonida's odd corners and secret spots: it pops when you stumble into the event it is tied to.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock a person down. KeenGamer reports the precise method is still being confirmed, so try a slow drive-by with a melee swing at a pedestrian and repeat until it registers.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to launder them, and the total adds up until it hits $250,000. Keep robbing and laundering and the trophy comes on its own.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spending adds up across every shop in the game: clothes, weapons, food and more. Big purchases speed it up, and by the time you have bought gear, garages and vehicles for the other trophies, this one is usually close.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: 8 purchasable garages in total, according to KeenGamer. Buy every garage on the market as you earn money; each one also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find or buy ten different vehicles and register each one through the app. Owning garages from Little Boxes gives you somewhere to keep them.
